1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __without disrupting embryo cell viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __through a process comprising exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __wherein the molecular analysis is genotyping__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after the molecular analysis is complete__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the embryos are immature embryos__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme __selected from the group consisting of cellulase, pectinase, and hemicellulase__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __or another cell wall degrading enzyme__.

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using magnetic particles or other solid phase extraction methods__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __and the method further comprises storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d)__.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without destroying embryo viability__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __and is performed prior to germination of the embryo__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA extracted from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after genotype-based selection is complete__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos __based on genotype__ is automated.
